AnalyticsOutcomes.title: Outcomes
AnalyticsOutcomes.unavailable: This report is unavailable. Refresh to try again.

coverage.backfilling: Historical data is still being projected. Counts are incomplete.
coverage.stale: The projection is delayed. Recent outcomes may be missing.
coverage.unavailable: Projection failed. These counts have incomplete coverage.

AnalyticsOutcomes.truncated: This report reached its limit; it does not cover the full population.
AnalyticsOutcomes.cohortDefinition: Entries in the selected period; outcomes within {days} days, ending at the next entry. Refunds follow the original purchase.
AnalyticsOutcomes.qualificationHelp: Qualifying means reaching one of these CRM stages during the observation window. Sales require confirmed ledger evidence.
AnalyticsOutcomes.saveFailed: Rule could not be saved. Refresh the rule and try again.
AnalyticsOutcomes.emptyCohort: New entry facts appear after the projection catches up.
AnalyticsOutcomes.efficiencyHelp: Efficiency requires mature entries, complete spend, matching currencies/time zones, one local source per ad and a verified WhatsApp destination with no ad-set update since the period began. Qualification cost also requires retained stage history throughout the period.
AnalyticsOutcomes.identityCoverage: {count} ad entries have incomplete click, ad or source identity.
AnalyticsOutcomes.attentionScope: Current active qualified customers, using their primary chat; as of {date}.
AnalyticsOutcomes.deliveryScope: Distinct outbound messages across AI, manual, scenario and campaign sends. Replies use the next send or a 7-day cutoff.
AnalyticsOutcomes.pricingHelp: Provider costs are approximate and cover the WhatsApp account. They are separate from phone-filtered delivery and AI usage costs. Unknown tariff coverage is not zero spend.
AnalyticsOutcomes.templateScope: WhatsApp account metrics, collected within provider tracking eligibility. Reads and clicks are tracked for 7 days after send; unavailable values stay blank.
AnalyticsOutcomes.healthScope: Current source state and last observed verification. A current snapshot cannot establish historical uptime.
AnalyticsOutcomes.activationHelp: Insights activation is a separate irreversible provider choice. It is never enabled automatically by this report.

insights.adminOnly: Only a workspace admin can turn on template insights.
insights.confirmDescription: Meta adds insights to this WhatsApp Business Account, including link tracking on template buttons, and collects anonymized data from your chats with customers. Template sends, deliveries, reads and clicks then appear here; reads and clicks are counted for 7 days after each send.
insights.permanent: This is permanent: Meta doesn't let anyone turn template insights off again.
insights.enabled: Template insights are on. Template numbers appear as Meta reports them.

errors.reconnect: Meta access for this WhatsApp account has expired or lacks permission, so insights can't be turned on yet.
errors.unsupported: Meta doesn't offer template insights for accounts connected through the WhatsApp Business app, so they can't be turned on for this account.
errors.busy: Meta is busy right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.forbidden: Only a workspace admin can turn on template insights.
errors.failed: Template insights couldn't be turned on. Try again.

AnalyticsOutcomes.flowScope: Distinct sent Flow instances, delivered/read/submitted, then confirmed outcomes after submission until the next submission or observation cutoff. Read does not measure opening; no submission does not prove cancellation.
AnalyticsOutcomes.retentionScope: Customers grouped by first confirmed purchase month, with repeat purchases within {days} days. Values are separated by currency.
AnalyticsOutcomes.retentionIdentity: {count} purchases lack a stable customer identity and are excluded from repeat-buyer counts.
AnalyticsOutcomes.dailyDeliveryScope: Send-day cohorts observed now; late receipts update their original send day.
AnalyticsOutcomes.healthHistoryScope: Daily observations captured by sync. Pending and failures cover the preceding seven send days; gaps are unobserved.
AnalyticsOutcomes.qualificationCoverage: Qualification uses recorded CRM stage events; older stage history may be incomplete.
AnalyticsOutcomes.retentionMaturity: Recent customer cohorts are still being observed; compare mature cohorts with the same window.
AnalyticsOutcomes.templateHistoryScope: Retained template status, quality and category events. Missing intervals were not observed.
AnalyticsOutcomes.serviceHistoryScope: Confirmed resolutions, reopens and handoffs since collection began. Recovery snapshots describe current episodes and cannot reconstruct missed transitions.
AnalyticsOutcomes.pricingDetails: Cost by market, category and tier
AnalyticsOutcomes.qualifiedToPaidHelp: Qualified-to-paid counts only confirmed purchases recorded at or after a qualifying stage within the entry window. The rate requires mature cohorts and complete recorded stage history.
